name: Master’s Proficiency
body:
School divination; Level antipaladin 1, bard 1, cleric/oracle 1, inquisitor 1, lathspell 1, legendary ninja 1, paladin 1, sorcerer/wizard 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 swift action
Components S, F (a weapon or shield)

EFFECT

Range personal
Target self
Duration 10 minutes/level (D)

DESCRIPTION

With a touch, the knowledge of soldiers and generals flows through you. When you cast this spell you draw the focus with a flourish and gain proficiency with the specific item used as the focus of this spell. If you are already proficient with the item used as the focus for this spell it instead gains an enhancement bonus to attack rolls equal to 1/4 your caster level, rounded down (minimum +1).
